ns2:course.label: Introd to the Art of Music
ns2:course.description: Provides non-music majors with basic listening skills, the ability to discuss music intelligently, and an acquaintance with many types of music. Prerequisite: For non-music majors only. Students must register for one lecture and one discussion section.
